title: novel chapter context <chapter-id> --view <view> --budget <n> --json output
description: Stable structured JSON output of `novel chapter context <chapter-id> --view <view> --budget <n> --json`. Renders CLI canonical Chapter Context Packet (P0/P1 subset with data backing + audit + overflow). Source: chapter-context spec, design D1-D7. Controlled view names reference contracts/cli/views-scopes.md §A group 4. Budget is token estimate (character approximation, no tokenizer dependency).

schemaVersion.description: CLI Contract schema version. Decimal integer string. Current: "9".

view.description: Controlled view name (views-scopes.md §A group 4). Differentiates fragment filtering in the service layer; renderer is view-agnostic.

limit.description: Budget limit from --budget (token estimate, character approximation).

used.description: Token estimate actually consumed by filled fragments (character approximation).

fragments.description: Filled context fragments (P0/P1 subset with data backing). Empty when chapter has no backing entities.

id.description: Fragment identifier (stable within this packet, e.g. "p0-hard-constraints", "p1-thread-bindings").

priority.description: Context priority. P0 (Authority/Gate, incompressible), P1 (Chapter Contract minimum + key bindings). Layers without data backing are omitted, not compressed.

items.description: Stable entity reference, composite-key string form (see entity-ids-sourcerefs.md). Patterns: constraint:<type>:<scope>:<name>, verdict:<chapter-id>:<node-id>, chapter:<chapter-id>, thread:<thread-id>, mainplot:<node-id>, volume_goal:<volume-id>:<goal-id>.

sourceRefs.description: Stable entity references; no internal paths or rowids.

content.description: Fragment content (plain text, may be summary-form after compression). Empty string allowed.

compressed.description: Fragments compressed (full→summary) to fit budget. Empty when none compressed.

sourceRefs.description: Stable entity references of the compressed fragment.

failures.description: Budget-exceeded failures when P0/P1_min overruns budget. Non-empty when exit code 3 + context_budget_exceeded. Empty on success.

audit.description: Audit records of compression and budget failures.

omitted.description: Layers omitted (no data backing or budget-exhausted). Non-empty includes chapter-contract/snapshot layers without entity tables (reason="no_data_backing_table").

sourceRefs.description: Stable entity references if applicable; empty array when no entity backing.
